title: 1991 Upper Deck Mark McGwire The Bashing Years Oakland Athletics #656 - Set Of 2
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a set of two 1991 Upper Deck trading cards featuring Mark McGwire of the Oakland Athletics during the "Bashing Years." These baseball cards are from the Major League (MLB) and showcase a young McGwire during his time with the Oakland Athletics. The cards are part of the 1991 Upper Deck set and are a valuable addition for fans and collectors of baseball memorabilia. Each card is numbered 656 and represents a piece of baseball history from the early 1990s.
